text: Varnholt Logistics said in a March filing with the Auric Exchange that its board had appointed Dorian Feltz as chief executive, effective March 18, replacing interim head Mara Venn. The company said Mr. Feltz, 52, previously led the freight division of Halcyon Transit Group and would oversee a five-year restructuring aimed at cutting costs by 12 percent. In a statement attached to the filing, chair Lenora Pike said the appointment followed a unanimous vote after a two-month search. The record showed Mr. Feltz receiving a base salary of 1.4 million crowns, plus performance awards tied to cargo volume and margin targets. Varnholt employs about 8,600 people across 14 depots.
